import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        print('no')
        return
    N = data[0]
    K = data[1]
    arr = data[2:2+N]
    seen = set()
    for x in arr:
        if (K - x) in seen:
            print('yes')
            return
        seen.add(x)
    print('no')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
